characters.name: A Vingadora
characters.prompt: Identity-preserving 2.5D oil-painted six-scene sheet. Keep A Vingadora's exact warm tan-brown skin, amber eyes, angular face, asymmetrical jaw-length black hair with shaved right temple, red-orange braid, sleeveless black high-neck tunic, torn crimson mantle, broad sash, cracked black iron right bracer and caged ember lantern at left hip. Visible oil brushwork and impasto, dramatic ember light, soot shadows, painterly anime forms, irregular graphic contours and restrained halftone energy. Scenes: portrait at a basalt causeway; passive retaliation from a burned enemy and close guard; single-target physical burn shown through target reaction only; defensive guard deflecting one incoming blade; Cerco Incandescente as an overhead effect-only scene with exactly three enemies losing shield protection and no foreground hands; solo ash-veil evasion. Natural connected anatomy and five-finger hands where visible; avoid extra limbs, detached hands, duplicate bodies, gore, text and watermark.

corrections.reason: Replaced the foreground hand pose with an effect-only overhead view of three affected enemies, making the area attack legible and removing the anatomy anomaly.

alternativeArt.name: Revanche Ardente
alternativeArt.prompt: Standalone spiritual single-target counterattack: one armored target recoils under a compact violet-red ember seal while the same Vingadora identity is implied at the frame edge by the crimson mantle, iron bracer and caged lantern. No visible hand or foreground attack pose; painterly oil impasto, 2.5D anime, dramatic ember light and coherent anatomy.

review: The active identity reference is A Vingadora: black asymmetrical hair, red-orange braid, cracked right bracer, crimson mantle and left-hip lantern.
Cerco Incandescente shows exactly three enemies and reads as area damage plus shield removal.
Cerco's previous foreground arm/hand pose is no longer in the active route.
Guarda Vingativa and Passo entre Brasas use distinct defensive compositions; the visible hand in Passo remains attached to a coherent arm.
Six card assets are 512x512 WebP. The Revanche alternate is also painterly and mapped to its own ability form. Gameplay was not changed.
